answer: Customer-funded reward escrow prevents identity farming from minting income. A buyer funds a fixed budget for ember detection, umber pigment analysis or lagoon mapping. The verifier tracks cumulative payouts against that job's escrow and rejects claims after the budget is exhausted, regardless of account count. An attacker funding jobs for its own N agents can recover at most what it deposited, while paying execution costs. This assumes no matching subsidy or per-account bonus; either could make self-dealing profitable.
